title: is_closed() after empty batch still correct post-select
description: After the select change, the only path to an empty batch is when all events in a coalesced batch are filtered out by the type filter (the select already handles client disconnect at the blocking point). The is_closed() check at line 379 is a belt-and-suspenders secondary check: if the client disconnects between the select returning and this point, is_closed() catches it and exits the loop. Correct and still needed; not redundant.
